purpose: Programs that the transitional C backend once got wrong, kept as regression cases, and the adversarial cases added when the constructs were fixed. Each one is valid Core 0.1 that argorixc core-check accepts, and every expectation comes from spec/core/evaluation.md. g01-g16 were issue #27 (ESP-009.B); g17-g23 were issue #39 and f01-f08 cover the same constructs; m01-m02 are programs of two modules, issue #45 (ESP-009.F). Files without a case of their own are modules those programs import.

cases.was: Array typedefs were emitted sorted by name, so the outer array preceded the inner one.
Struct definitions were emitted alphabetically instead of in dependency order.
The array typedef came before the struct it holds.
A block expression's locals landed in the enclosing C scope.
A unit function whose tail is a call emitted `return <value>;` inside void.
Array types declared inside a branch never got their typedef.
Struct field names reached C unprefixed, so `long` and `char` collided.
An unused parameter or uncalled private function failed -Werror.
A comparison pushed its own bool type into the operand.
A shadowed local kept the inner type after its scope closed, and printed 233.
A variable operand was read after the right side mutated it, and printed 4.
`if` in statement position was rejected at emission.
Shifts were rejected at emission.
Signed negation was rejected at emission.

Recursion past the native stack ended in SIGSEGV instead of a typed trap. The spec allows either the result or a typed resource trap; the runtime now charges a call-depth budget and traps below the stack limit.
Arithmetic containing an `if` was rejected when it was a comparison operand.
`loop` used as a statement asked its body for a scalar type and was rejected at emission. Fixed in ESP-009.F.
A `loop` used as a value and its `break value` were outside the C profile. Fixed in ESP-009.F.
`match` on a bool was rejected: only enum scrutinees were lowered. Fixed in ESP-009.F.
Module constants were not lowered at all. Fixed in ESP-009.F.
`match` on an integer with a literal arm and `_` was rejected. Fixed in ESP-009.F.
Match guards were rejected at emission. Fixed in ESP-009.F.
`x = x;` became a C self-assignment that clang rejects under -Werror. Fixed in ESP-009.F.
A false guard must fall through to the next arm, and a later arm of the same variant must still match. Added with ESP-009.F.
A negative scrutinee must not match the literal of its magnitude; it reaches `_`. Added with ESP-009.F.
A binding pattern is a catch-all that copies the scrutinee into a new local. Added with ESP-009.F.
A plain `break` inside a `while` nested in a value `loop` ends the `while`, not the `loop`. Added with ESP-009.F.
A `match` in statement position runs its arm for effects and has no result. Added with ESP-009.F.
A constant whose initializer reads another constant. Added with ESP-009.F.
A local shadows a module constant of the same name. Added with ESP-009.F.

Issue #45: an import brought no symbols into scope, so no multi-module program compiled. This one calls a public function and reads a public constant through two bindings of the same module, and both modules define a private `bump`. Fixed in ESP-009.F.
Issue #45: public struct and enum types of an imported module, named by their bare name, constructed by the importer and matched on; both modules define a private `Cursor`. Fixed in ESP-009.F.
A `match` whose scrutinee is an `if` expression was emitted without an expected type and rejected; the differential generator found it the first time it produced integer matches. Fixed in ESP-009.F.
A Buffer passed by value was released by the callee and again by the caller: a double free under AddressSanitizer. The argument now moves into the callee, which owns it (ESP-009).
`b[i] = x` on a Buffer was rejected at emission: only a local could be assigned (ESP-009).
A Buffer moved into a struct field: the struct owns it and releases it through its drop function (ESP-009).
A returned Buffer was released by the callee before it returned, so the caller read an empty one and printed 0 instead of 1, silently. The returned local is now moved out first (ESP-009).
`h.values.push(x)`, `h.values[i] = x` and `h.count = ..` on a struct holding a Buffer, after a Buffer built and returned by a function (ESP-009).
A result-like enum carrying a Buffer, returned early or late, matched by value; an arm that does not bind the payload releases it (ESP-009).
A Buffer of Buffers filled in a loop with `continue`, read with a `loop` and `break`, and a Buffer declared inside a loop body: each is released exactly once on every path (ESP-009).
